maddeler.e:
احتكمن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَكَمْنَ (iḥtakamna) /iħ.ta.kam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَكَمَ (iḥtakama)
# اِحْتَكِمْنَ (iḥtakimna) /iħ.ta.kim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَكَمَ (iḥtakama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
